notes.title: Location swamp
notes.content:
What kind of souls-like is it if there is no swamp in it.
But the swamp in Forbidden myths is significantly different from the swamp in Dark souls.
In Slavic folklore, it is one of the most dangerous places. It is literally a home for evil spirits and other evil spirits.
We want the player to be able to feel all the danger that lurks in the swamps. Therefore, its passage will be a separate test, comparable to the next boss.

[h2] How does it work?[/h2]
The swamp consists of small islands, between which you will have to make a route. But the depth around the island is different and if you turn the wrong way, you risk drowning.
You will have to find the way by touch, carefully checking the depth of the paths between the islands.
The path will be complicated by fog, which does not allow you to see further than the neighboring island and complicates navigation.

[b]But there are also good sides to this location.[/b]
First, there are no dead ends here. If you were able to move from one island to another, then you are going the right way.
Secondly, all the islands differ well from each other. And if you remember them carefully, you will be able to navigate the swamps.
Efforts should be rewarded, and if the bosses give the player new levels, then the swamp is filled with stories and references. You can see one of these in the screenshot.

notes.title: The history of drawing a hut on chicken legs.
notes.content:
This model is unique in that it was not drawn by a 3D artist, but by a level designer who is not particularly strong in this.
The reason for this is the absence, at the moment, of work from a level designer and a large load from a 3D artist.

But first, a little history. Where did the image of such a hut come from?
In ancient times, the Slavs made log cabins in the forest by placing them on stumps with chopped roots to protect the tree from rotting — they were carefully scalded and fumigated with acrid smoke. This procedure allowed to expel insects and protect the wood from decomposition. Gradually, the meaning of the word was forgotten, it became unclear why the legs were chicken. Such houses were used not only for living, but also as a warehouse or tombs. It was the latter application that gave rise to the mystical image in modern folklore. A house on a chicken leg is the border of the world of the living and the dead.

The first screenshot was made quite late, when the pipe and the base were already there. Of interest here is the texture of the pipe. Unlike the hut itself, its material was drawn from scratch in a blender. Using a grid and color generation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42777346/1b2e2e0fd2ba61cb03c61053357f2e028e3eec30.jpg[/img]
After that, dirt and a boarded-up window were added. After all, according to folklore, the hut "stands without windows, without doors"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42777346/7524c9a012baab77c47e91b69511c7669bd9f29e.jpg[/img]
Next, the texture of the hut was correctly configured through UV scanning.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42777346/26f4ad92c4b510b5f7dfecbe9364b59ddafdd3cb.jpg[/img]
And the final touch is chicken legs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42777346/078e70dc02266f3fbac9efe1fb4d0628f2ce5598.jpg[/img]
It remained to transfer the model to Unreal engeen 5, but then problems began. The model was divided into component parts, and almost all materials were not loaded. After several unsuccessful ones, I had to turn to a 3D artist. He was able to solve the problem, but the texture of the dirt suffered changes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42777346/733d828de4ec45030add6ad55416db8d76603022.jpg[/img]
In the next part, we will talk about creating a scene using a hut.

notes.title: Rock
notes.content:
[h2]Mythology[/h2]
In Slavic mythology, there is a creature so negative that Mother earth herself rejects it. It cannot set foot on the damp earth - only on a stone. This monster devours people and cattle, and he dies only from fire. It was said that he himself spews fire. It lives in a mountainous area, all alone

[h2]Game[/h2]
It is for him that our hero will go to climb a high rock to find and destroy this creature. But in order to defeat him, you will have to master the basics.

[h2]Location design[/h2]
In addition to the opportunity to climb the rock, it will play an important role in navigation. Focusing on it, you will be able to get out of a dense forest or foggy swamp. And also, climbing on it, you will be able to view most of the map from a bird's-eye view, enjoying the magnificent view. The main thing is not to get dizzy from the view.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42777346/603e0dc2920de7af9618702db90c03bafc8b3c2e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Forest
notes.content:
[h2]Culture[/h2]
The forest in general and the trees in particular for the Slavs were considered a road to another world, a kind of looking glass.
Even a tree was planted on the grave, so that there would be somewhere for the soul to go.

Of course, all this did not arise from scratch, because the forest has always attracted our ancestors as an otherworldly and enticing force. They perfectly felt the nature of the forest, and therefore settled next to it.
A person's life was also connected with the forest. Not for nothing at the birth of a child, a tree was planted at home. Even modern sayings are echoes of the past, the foundation of life "to build a house, give birth to a son and plant a tree"

The forest for the Slavs served as a source of building material, fuel, various products - mushrooms, berries, nuts. It was possible to hunt in the forest, to get a bird or an animal. The forest remained the only source of honey and wax for a long time. What is also very important - the forest has always served the Slavs as a defender. The forest made it possible to hide from destructive raids. The forest sheltered people from death and slavery. Therefore, the forest was a good, kind force. During paganism, a forest or part of it could become sacred - reserved. Hunting of animals and birds was forbidden in the sacred groves, it was strictly forbidden to cut trees in these groves, various rituals were performed there, perhaps the dead were buried. The tradition of sacred, reserved, holy groves has not become a thing of the past with the advent of Christianity

At the same time, the Eastern Slavs were farmers and the struggle with the forest for the liberation of new arable lands was their daily hard work. Therefore, the forest was perceived as a hostile environment. In the forest, you could get lost and die. The forest could punish an alien for carelessness. Wild animals lived in the forest, predators that attacked cattle and people, inflicted damage to crops. Robbers and "dashing people" hid in the forest, from where they came out to rob ordinary people. Moreover, the Slavs inhabited the forest with many creatures hostile to man, which should be feared - goblins, kikimores and other malicious spirits. In the worldview of the Slavs, the forest often acted as another, separate world, not the one in which people lived, but an otherworldly world, and therefore dangerous.

Nevertheless, the Eastern Slavs, as people living among forests, treated the forest as part of their world and, subject to certain rules, rituals and customs, such cohabitation was kind. It's just that you can go to this grove and everything will be fine, but it's better not to go to that thicket beyond the river, or you may not return.

[h2]Game[/h2]
In the game, the forest is the main location where the character will spend most of the time. Only in this place there will be peaceful characters ready to help the main character. There will be no goblin known to many in the game. Instead, we decided to take a similar, but less well-known creature.
From the point of view of optimization, the forest is the most difficult location. Because trees have many polygons and are needed in large numbers.
Since the game will start right away in the forest, you will immediately be able to determine whether your computer is suitable for our game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42777346/540c0963413cfbd4d0614456126469908bdd08db.png[/img]

notes.title: Folklore and mythology
notes.content:
When creating lore, we had a small conflict between Folklore and mythology.
In Folklore, such characters as Koschei the immortal, Baba Yaga, Viy or Serpent Gorynych are ordinary characters, most often protagonists. You can see them, talk to them and win. But in mythology, all these creatures are gods.
Koschei, Viy and Serpent are the children of Chernobog. The main god of Navi, the world of the dead. And Baba Yaga is the daughter of Viya and the wife of Veles, the god of trade. And in the myths, she is not an old woman, but a young warrior.
We absolutely did not want to create an analogue of the ghost of Sparta in the Slavic world, but also wanted to preserve the already historically established folklore. Therefore, it was decided to find a balance between it and mythology.

[h2]Solution[/h2]
If we recall Greek mythology, there were semi-gods there. Children of gods and mortals who possessed supernatural abilities, but were mortal. Such, for example, was Hercules. We decided to use a similar situation in our game, making all the conflicting characters demigods.

[h2]Results[/h2]
In the lore of the game, demigods are the children of the gods, but not necessarily from union with mortals. You can see them, talk to them and defeat them. The demigods themselves can come into contact with both mortals and gods. Including having a love relationship with them.
But ordinary mortals can only feel the existence of the gods through their actions. But they can't hear their voice, see or touch.
It is worth mentioning separately about Baba Yaga. In our history, she will be an old woman, but this old woman has an interesting youth in the past.

notes.title: Mechanics is a reward for perseverance
notes.content:
[h1]Hard work and patience should be rewarded.[/h1]
Therefore, we have come up with a special mechanic for those who have been trying hard to overcome difficulties for a long time.
Forbidden myths is a challenging game. Each boss is unique and requires a different approach. Therefore, many players may take more than a dozen attempts to kill them. And then the modification of the skill will come to his aid.
[h2]How does it work?[/h2]
When you apply the skill a certain number of times, it will be possible to improve it by choosing a modification at your discretion.
Improvements have 3 stages: bronze, silver and gold. Each stage is a stronger new modification, but it is also more difficult to get it.
The key point is that the progress of obtaining a modification is preserved after death.
Therefore, if you cannot pass the boss for a long time, the game will give you the opportunity to become stronger and make it easier to get a victory.
At the same time, no one forces you to use the modification - if you wish, you can refuse it if you do not want to strengthen the character.

notes.title: Svarog
notes.content:
[h1]The blacksmith God and creator of the earth[/h1]

[h2]Mythology[/h2]
In peacetime, he was portrayed as a blacksmith who works in the Heavenly Forge.
In a state of war – as a Great warrior in red or burgundy armor, in whose hands was a huge sword made of damask steel.
He was valued because of his ability to make tools.

He creates with the help of his hands, and not with words or magic like Veles
He considers people his children. He takes care of them accordingly: he gave them the Sun and fire to cook food and keep warm in the cold.
He taught them how to make cottage cheese and cheese, which were previously considered divine, sacred food.
He made an axe for protection from enemies and a bowl in which the sacred drink was prepared.

According to legend, Svarog found the Alatyr stone, which was magical. After the spell, the stone increased in size and became snow-white hot.
With this stone, the Heavenly God created foam in the ocean, which later became the first land.
Alatyr also had another use – Svarog beat on it with his hammer and new gods and heavenly warriors appeared from the sparks flying around.
On his anvil, Alatyr, he created a plow and a yoke, and dropped them from heaven as a gift for cultivating the land

[h2]Game[/h2]
One of the features of Svarog's development is passive skills. They are well suited for those who do not want to be distracted by extra buttons for applying skills.
Another plus of the passive skills branch is balance, they are equally useful against each boss.
Svarog will allow you to strengthen not only the defense and attack, but also the effectiveness of the shield and counterattack.
At a high level of development, Svarog provides an opportunity for additional recovery of health.
And one of his final skills makes it possible to remove positive effects from the enemy - Koschei the immortal will be very upset)

notes.title: The complexities of Slavic mythology
notes.content:
Unlike Greek, Egyptian or Scandinavian mythology, Slavic did not have time to finally form. This leads to the fact that there is no clear hierarchy of the pantheon. Also, this is complicated by the variety of Slavs. Even nowadays, according to Wikipedia, they are divided into Eastern (3 peoples), Western (6 peoples) and southern (7 peoples), plus 10 peoples with a disputed status. And now imagine that they were all divided into conditional clans, with their own traditions and customs.

How many such peoples could live only on one territory of modern Russia? Yes, not only Slavs live there, but it's still a very large scale. And it's good if it just gives more information, but often the facts begin to contradict each other, and you have to think about how to resolve these conflicts.

The task is complicated by the struggle of Orthodoxy with paganism. Vladimir I alone destroyed a huge number of sources of information about paganism.

But perhaps the most important problem is the neo-pagans. This is a sect of people who seriously believe in Slavic paganism. They worship Perun, and use the Veles Book as a bible. Only this is not an invaluable source of information about Slavic culture and mythology, but the most common falsification. Scientists have studied it a long time ago and made a clear conclusion, but this does not stop sectarians. Therefore, they actively spread misinformation. As a result, in addition to the complex search for information, it needs to be checked several more times.

Well, the last fact is the lack of attention of historians or society to Slavic mythology. Because of this, it is not as well studied as analogies from Greece, Egypt or Scandinavia. And there are few good books in which you can get acquainted at all.

For example, I acquired the Paganism of the Ancient Slavs from Rybakov. And with all the contribution to the science of this historian, it is extremely difficult to read.

Therefore, I want to apologize in advance if there are mistakes or fakes in our game. We try to check the information, but there are a lot of pitfalls with this.

Finally, I want to thank the Seven Legends and the NOISE of the EARTH channels for high-quality content on the topics we need.

If you know good sources of information about Slavic culture or, even better, mythology - write about it in the comments. this will greatly help in the development of the laura game.

notes.title: The main character's weapon
notes.content:
When creating the main character's weapon, we tried to observe:
1. Historicity - weapons must correspond to the era and location.
2. Originality - swords are too common, the God of War already has an axe
3. Interesting - so that it would be pleasant to own it, it's a matter of taste, but for us personally, such a weapon as a spear did not fit this criterion.
Having reviewed a lot of weapon options. We settled on two options:
Shestoper or mace-morgenstern.
The six-pointer corresponded well to the point of interest. It was a pleasure to own such a weapon. This weapon was used by the Cold Valley Vord, which Dark Souls 3 fans could appreciate. But this weapon had a problem with historicity. This weapon appeared at a later time. And it appeared on the territory of Western Europe.
The club had exactly the opposite situation - it was not so interesting, but it fully corresponded to historicity.
As a result, our artist decided to draw both options and compare them in the game.
He drew the club first and immediately after the image was received, all doubts disappeared.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42777346/a3cc3bdb18c0cc2f44ce2ae6d59b1bbc092d56e6.jpg[/img]
The model turned out to be very successful. And it was clearly decided to use this particular weapon, since now it is not only historically correct, but also interesting. I want to own this club, it makes me want to use it in battle.
Just in case, the shestoper was also drawn, but the result only confirmed the decision.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42777346/2429b1e1496837d48082b68844f538c66f146fc7.jpg[/img]
The weapon turned out to be beautiful, but it could not surpass the first option, but I think it's even for the best.

notes.title: Drawing the forest Famously
notes.content:
[h1]Famously One-eyed[/h1]
Ogre, a character in Slavic mythology. She has disheveled hair, sharp claws and only one eye on her forehead. Famously inhabits the swamp. She has a magical skull that screams for people. When they come close, Famously rushes at them and devours them.

Some sources indicate that famously has an eye on the forehead, but we decided to make an eye on the right side, for three reasons.
1. The eye in the middle strongly resembles a creature from Greek mythology - a Cyclops. We want our creatures to be unique.
2. According to mythology, famously knows how to take other people's forms, but there will always be one eye. Therefore, it famously covers the second half of the face with elements of the image. For example, having turned into a young girl, she will famously cover part of her face with a strand of hair.
This mechanic will be in the game, and in order for it to look logical, the eye must be on one side, otherwise it will move when changing appearance, which is very strange.
3. Symmetry is one of the important properties of the beauty of the face, therefore, removing it, the creature will turn out to be more ugly, as it should be.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42777346/186defd6a7da083154254abd51b56cc41ab3ee9a.jpg[/img]

In the original version, the eye would just be closed. And famously looked more like an ordinary grandmother than a monster. Therefore, we decided to align the left side of the face, removing hints of the presence of an eye, and increase and shift the eye itself. In addition, we changed the skin color and added traces of blood

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42777346/95d648a377f0213e784fab0b5c66475ca2bc2bec.jpg[/img]

After that, we came to the conclusion that we need to somehow highlight the eye. So that it does not merge with the background of the bloody skin.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42777346/c7802b5fd8ec19f1af5e4fa32e3997fe8b7a44c8.jpg[/img]

We will further refine the eye, as well as pay attention to the mouth. We deform the nose more.

[b]Important[/b]: the screenshots are still a raw version of the model. The final result will be much better.
